title: BEOL-Compatible Oxide Semiconductor Twin-Gate FeFET Achieving a Record-High Memory Window of 25.4 V and a Near-Ideal Memory Window-to-Operation Voltage Ratio of 1.88
venue: IEEE Symposium on VLSI Technology and Circuits
summary: We demonstrate a twin-gate architecture for BEOL-compatible oxide-semiconductor FeFETs with channel lengths down to 30 nm, achieving a record-high memory window of 25.4 V at 13.5 V operation (memory-window-to-operation-voltage ratio 1.88, near the theoretical limit) while retaining over 15 V after 10⁷ cycles.

title: Multi-Grain Ferroelectric Induced Drain Current Variability in BEOL-Compatible OS FeFETs
summary: We study intrinsic variability in BEOL-compatible ZnO-channel OS FeFETs scaled to 40 nm, finding drain-current variation rises monotonically under full switching but non-monotonically under partial switching, driven by stochastic percolation and ferroelectric grain inhomogeneity.

title: First Demonstration of Oxide Semiconductor BEOL-Compatible Dual-Gate FeFET Achieving a Record-Low Operation Voltage of 0.5 V and a Record-High Memory Window-to-Operation Voltage Ratio of 1.62
summary: Using gate-area-ratio engineering, we demonstrate a dual-gate OS FeFET operating at a record-low 0.5 V with endurance over 10⁹ cycles, and a record-high memory-window-to-operation-voltage ratio of 1.62 at 1.25 V.

title: First Demonstration of 3D Fe-VNAND with Function-Separated Dual-Layer Oxide Semiconductor Channel and Laminated Ferroelectric Stack
summary: We demonstrate the first 3D ferroelectric vertical NAND with a dual-layer oxide-semiconductor channel and a laminated ferroelectric stack, reaching a 9.6 V memory window in the 3D string with endurance and retention beyond 10⁹ cycles.

title: A Generalizable Tri-Layer Design Framework for Enhancing OSFET Reliability
venue: IEEE Symposium on VLSI Technology and Circuits
summary: We propose a tri-layer design that tackles positive and negative bias temperature instability together, using a hydrogen-reservoir top layer and a hydrogen-barrier passivation layer to reach a record-low threshold-voltage shift in IGZTO FETs.

title: Toward Nanoscale Organic Tunnel Field-Effect Transistors with Small Subthreshold Swing and High On-State Current: A Computational Design Based on Two-Dimensional Covalent-Organic Frameworks
summary: Using first-principles and quantum-transport calculations, we design nanoscale organic tunnel FETs based on two-dimensional covalent-organic frameworks with subthreshold swing down to 21 mV/dec and on-state current up to 887.5 μA/μm, meeting IRDS targets for high-performance and low-power devices.
